title: 1828 Prairie's porch gets its arches, and its bay its basement lights
items: The Shipman house at 1828 Prairie: round arches on the porch's front and south side, springing from its columns' capitals under the carved entablature, as the c. 1900 photograph with the automobile shows them.
Under the canted bay's three tall windows, barred basement lights as tall and wide as the photograph's, where the bay's base stood blank.
